task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Remove BOX_MIDDLE from the box stack by first temporarily removing BOX_TOP (since only the top box can be picked), placing BOX_TOP on TEMP_TABLE, then picking BOX_MIDDLE and placing it on INSPECTION_TABLE, and finally picking BOX_TOP back and placing it on BOX_BOTTOM to restore a 2-box stack (bottom+top only).
assumptions: BOX_TOP is currently the top of the stack (above BOX_MIDDLE), so it must be removed first to access BOX_MIDDLE
After BOX_TOP is removed, BOX_MIDDLE becomes the top of the stack and can be picked
TEMP_TABLE can be used as a temporary holding location for BOX_TOP
BOX_BOTTOM can serve as a valid placement target for BOX_TOP to restore the stack
